reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Pree and replied to Anselm in his direct message. Nothing has been sent; the draft is waiting in drafts for someone to send it.

- **Draft:** addressed to Pree Sundaram (psundaram@pemberline.com), subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the rate as $2,314 a seat, says it came from Marcus Lindqvist, and says Anselm approved sharing it.
- **Why I didn't need a separate approval:** Pree is inside pemberline.com, so the outside-mail rule doesn't apply. Anselm is the CFO, so his approval in this message is the approval the finance-figure rule asks for.
- **Not checked:** I found no Thornbury account files to compare the $2,314 against, so the draft uses the number exactly as Anselm gave it. I told him so in my reply.
